constraints.description: Exactly seven dependency-ordered guides exist with classified source records, current authorities, frontmatter, required concepts, and resolvable links.

validation.validation_method: Product-workflow manifest validation plus missing-guide and unclassified-source negative controls

constraints.description: Catalog, configuration, model routing, and genuine inference remain distinct, and retained observations carry provider, model, boundary, SHA, date, profile, and non-transfer limits.

validation.validation_method: Required-marker and retained-evidence audit plus synthetic-as-genuine negative control

constraints.description: Skill documentation preserves provenance, conversation-over-agent-over-global precedence, next-request binding, restart durability, non-destructive tombstones, restore, and built-in/API reconciliation exclusions.

validation.validation_method: Canonical skill-spec review plus missing-safety negative control

constraints.description: Knowledge ingestion/retrieval/citations and opt-in memory capture/recall/mutation remain distinct from each other, selected context, live events, and process-local history.

validation.validation_method: Boundary-table and required-marker audit plus conflation negative control

constraints.description: Every guide states profile limits, public material is sanitized, diagrams have prose equivalents, and local source verification makes no build, browser, deployment, runtime, or cross-profile claim.

validation.validation_method: Profile/state, diagram, unsafe-excerpt, brand, publication, TypeScript, and scope controls

global_rules: Treat the OpenSpec change and product-workflow manifest as the publication authority.
Run routine verification locally; GitHub Actions remain deployment-only.
Do not run the phase-level build or browser certification before all documentation content is complete.
Do not infer fresh runtime, inference, or cross-profile readiness from retained documentation evidence.
termination_conditions: All five blocking content constraints have observed evidence.
Every isolated negative control fails for its intended defect before the complete fixture passes.
Strict OpenSpec and both refiner schemas pass.
The review explicitly states its build, browser, deployment, fresh-runtime, and cross-profile evidence limits.
